decisions.quote:
The second finding (
Table II
) partially replicated our previous work
33
revealing statistically significant pre- to post-intervention improvements in affect, anxiety, and craving. However, this was only true for the first two or three of the possible four sessions.
decisions.reason: The shipped quote covers only safety and feasibility, whereas the authors explicitly state in the discussion that the psychological outcome findings only partially replicated their previous study because significant improvements were limited to the first two or three of the four sessions. Because the authors themselves frame their results as partially replicating the original work, the outcome is mixed.
